text:
Assistant A engages with the role-play and asks relevant clarifying questions (location, duration, associated symptoms), which is how a real clinician would begin a diagnostic workup. It's helpful and moves the conversation forward, though it could have added some preliminary information or red-flag warnings.

Assistant B refuses outright, offering only a generic disclaimer. The user's request is a reasonable educational or hypothetical scenario, and general health information is fine to provide. B is unhelpful and provides no value beyond telling the user to see a doctor.

A is better.

[[A]]
